observationMethod: CUA real-page observation supplied by the root agent
claimBoundary: This journal records supplied CEAC current-live DOM observations for Personal Information 1-2, Travel Information, Travel Companions, Previous U.S. Travel, Address and Phone, Passport Information, U.S. Point of Contact, Family Information (Relatives, Spouse/Partner, Deceased Spouse, Former Spouse), Work/Education/Training (Present, Previous, Additional), Security and Background Parts 1-5, the photo upload/continue-without-photo path, and e-Sign preparer structure. It remains a partial live review and does not prove all DS-160 fields, options, pages, server rules, reload behavior, final signature, or visa-specific branches. No applicant answers are stored in this journal.
